name: DatePicker
summary: A field that opens a calendar to pick a date, or a range of dates.

a11y.apg: The trigger is a button that opens a dialog (the calendar in a popover). The dialog takes the field's name, focus moves to the chosen day (or today) when it opens, and Escape or choosing a date closes it and returns focus to the trigger. Inside, the calendar is the Calendar grid.
a11y.keyboardNote: Enter or Space on the trigger opens the calendar; the arrows, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End move the day inside it (the Calendar grid); Escape closes.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen date (controlled). With range, {from, to}.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting date when you do not control it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every pick. A single date closes the calendar; a range closes on the second pick.

props.name: range
props.description: Pick a range instead of one date. Every time the calendar opens, the first pick is one end and the second is the other, in any order — it does not stretch the range that was there.

props.name: minimumDate
props.description: Days before it are disabled, and the calendar does not go back past its month.

props.name: maximumDate
props.description: Days after it are disabled, and the calendar does not go past its month.

props.name: format
props.description: How a date is written on the trigger. The default is day, short month and year in the language of locale — English without it, the same on the server and in the browser.

props.name: locale
props.description: The language of the trigger AND the calendar, together: the object from react-day-picker/locale (import {ptBR} from "react-day-picker/locale"), the same one Calendar takes. It never comes from the environment, so the server and the browser write the same text.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text of the empty trigger. With range, strings.dateRangePlaceholder.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon at the end of the trigger; false removes it.

props.name: name
props.description: Sends the value with a form: yyyy-mm-dd, from the LOCAL date; a range goes as yyyy-mm-dd/yyyy-mm-dd, the ISO 8601 interval.

props.name: size
props.description: The field height, the same scale as Select and Input.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the TRIGGER, which is the focusable node — it is what a <label htmlFor> points at. Inside a Field, the Field gives it one.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the trigger when there is no visible label, and the calendar window too. With a Field, prefer the Field's label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Names the trigger and the calendar window by another element's id.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Goes to the trigger. It is spelled out because this component unpacks a fixed list of props and drops anything else.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the trigger, after the Aurea skin.
